name: MathNet
description: MathNet is a large-scale, multilingual, and multimodal benchmark of Olympiad-level mathematical problems spanning 40 countries and 10 languages. It supports mathematical comprehension, retrieval of equivalent problems, and retrieval-augmented generation tasks, providing a challenging testbed for reasoning and retrieval capabilities.
reputation: A promising new multilingual Olympiad-level math benchmark that is still emerging and has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Includes 39K pairs of mathematically equivalent problems for retrieval evaluation; publicly released dataset and benchmark
